name: Remote MCP Server (Authless)
description: Enables deployment of MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers without authentication requirements. Provides a template for creating custom MCP tools that can be accessed remotely via Cloudflare AI Playground or local MCP clients like Claude Desktop.
